## Notes

- The first reference recorded for this environment after the derived-threshold work: the local colima cluster on the
  chart defaults, with the load generator sharing the host, so the numbers are host-relative (as `2026-09-26.md` says).
- The knee is still not measured at the 200-unit/s ceiling; this plateau at 122 units/s is what the below-knee profiles
  derive their thresholds from, as `load-tests/src/gatling/resources/baseline.properties`.
- **0 failed requests**, where the pre-fix code KO'd 194 of 22,463 polls — the write stream's poll conditions crashed
  (`Can't parse '200 != 200' into boolean`), fixed in the same change.
